items.summary: Manchester City sit top of the Premier League with a perfect record of five wins from five matches under Enzo Maresca, and face a crucial test at Liverpool this Sunday where the hosts may be without key attackers Alexander Isak and Cody Gakpo.

source.title: Isak and Gakpo both doubtful for Liverpool-Man City clash

items.summary: Rival Premier League clubs are pushing for severe sanctions against City following their guilty verdict for financial breaches spanning 2009-2018, with some demanding multi-season points deductions and historic title stripping, while the club has lodged an appeal with a verdict deadline of January 23, 2027.

source.title: ‘Tariff-Based System’—The Sanctions Rival Clubs Want Man City to Face

items.summary: Erling Haaland asked to be substituted during Norways Nations League clash with Portugal due to fatigue from his grueling schedule, though manager Stale Solbakken downplayed injury concerns ahead of Citys trip to Anfield.

source.title: ‘Just Insane’—Norway Boss Provides Erling Haaland Update After Injury Scare
